class.name: SkeletonDefinition
class.brief_description: A named bone hierarchy and reference pose shared by 3D animation assets.
class.description: Stores bone names, parent indices, local rest transforms, and an embedded shared [AnimationLibrary] in a text [code].sk[/code] resource. Create one from [method Skeleton3D.create_skeleton_definition] or export it from the Skeleton3D editor menu. [member Animation.skeleton] associates an animation with this definition. Preview scene references are soft references resolved through the scene UID when available. Loading a skeleton definition does not load its preview model. Compatibility reports do not change bones or perform retargeting.

method.name: get_animation_library
method.description: Returns the embedded shared animation library, creating it if necessary. Save this skeleton after changing the collection.

method.name: compare
method.description: Compares bones by name, independently of their stored index order. Returns [code]compatible[/code], [code]hierarchy_matches[/code], [code]missing_bones[/code], [code]extra_bones[/code], [code]parent_mismatches[/code], and [code]rest_mismatches[/code]. Bone lists are [PackedStringArray] values relative to this definition. Empty definitions are incompatible. Compatibility requires identical names, parent relationships, and rest transforms within [param tolerance]. The tolerance is an absolute per-component difference for local position and Basis values. Scene root transforms and animation track paths are outside this comparison.

method.name: find_bone
method.description: Returns the named bone's index, or [code]-1[/code] if absent.

method.name: get_bone_name
method.description: Returns the bone name at [param index].

method.name: get_bone_parent
method.description: Returns the parent index, or [code]-1[/code] for a root bone.

method.name: set_bones
method.description: Replaces all bones atomically. Every dictionary must contain [code]name[/code] ([String] or [StringName]), [code]parent[/code] ([int]), and [code]rest[/code] ([Transform3D]). Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] for duplicate or empty names, names containing [code]:[/code] or [code]/[/code], invalid parents, cycles, or non-finite transforms. The input dictionaries are copied. Parent indices may appear after their children.

members.member: The embedded shared animation collection. Use [method get_animation_library] to obtain or initialize it. Clips remain standalone resources. Generated AnimationPlayers derive their default library from this skeleton instead of serializing a copy.
A read-only snapshot of the bone hierarchy and rest transforms. Use [method set_bones] to replace the complete definition.
Soft reference to the default [PackedScene] ([code].skmesh[/code]) used to preview animations. Resolved by UID when available. The preview model is loaded when opening the animation asset workspace.
